day_shape: 67 items: US Treasury authorises Iranian oil sales and Rubio announces UAE/Kuwait/Bahrain trip on the MoU, regime channels saturate with Khamenei funeral logistics for 15 Tir, Israel-Lebanon disarmament talks resume in Washington, no UK Parliament activity.

threads.label: US-Iran MoU implementation moves
threads.summary: The US Treasury authorised production, delivery and sale of Iranian oil under the agreement reached last week, and Secretary Rubio announced travel to the UAE, Kuwait and Bahrain on 23–25 June to discuss the MoU and Strait of Hormuz transit. Vice President JD Vance said 'good progress' was made in the Burgenstock talks, while IRIB claimed Iranian diplomats are in technical sessions on five provisions including lifting oil sanctions and reopening Hormuz.

threads.label: Israeli reactions to US-Iran deal
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post cited an Agam Institute/Hebrew University survey finding most Israelis view the MoU as a win for Tehran, and reported Trump's allies defending him to an anxious Israeli public. Times of Israel reported residents of Trump Heights expressing dismay at the deal, and a former Shin Bet chief Ronen Bar was evacuated from the UAE over an alleged Iranian-directed threat.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral logistics in Tehran
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB carried multiple announcements on the farewell at Tehran Mosalla on 13–14 Tir and the funeral on 15 Tir, with the Civil Aviation Organisation imposing flight restrictions at Mehrabad, Imam Khomeini, Qom and Mashhad airports. The Mashhad governor claimed expectations of 15 million attendees, with accommodation prepared for 1.5 million.

threads.label: Lebanon disarmament and deconfliction
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported Israeli and Lebanese delegations are set to meet in Washington for another round of Hezbollah disarmament and normalisation talks, while Qatar and Pakistan announced a joint Lebanon deconfliction mechanism. IRIB quoted parliament speaker Qalibaf saying Iran 'will not abandon Lebanon's territorial integrity until a conclusion is reached'.

threads.label: Iranian leadership messaging on America
threads.summary: Judiciary head Hujjat al-Islam Ejei told the Supreme Judiciary Council that trust in America is 'a mistake' and that the 'American-Zionist enemy' imposed two wars on Iran in the past year. IRGC political deputy Javani and adviser Sharif called for national unity, while IRIB framed negotiations as having progressed but with a 'taller wall of mistrust'.

threads.label: Iran regional diplomacy: Oman, Turkey, IAEA
threads.summary: Defa Press said Qalibaf will travel to Oman to meet Sultan Haitham bin Tariq on bilateral cooperation and 'Iranian arrangements for managing the Strait of Hormuz', accompanied by the foreign minister. IRIB reported a Pezeshkian-Erdogan call on economic ties, and Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei told IRNA that interactions with the IAEA would continue.

threads.label: IDF Gaza and West Bank operations
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet announced the killing in northern Gaza on Saturday of Nukhba operative Sabai Zaher Abd al-Hamid Abu Hasna, who had held hostage Omer Shem Tov, alongside three other Hamas operatives and West Jabalia engineering chief Ahmad Munir Khalil Zaza. The IDF also reported 240+ firearms confiscated in Judea and Samaria since the start of 2026.

A blessing beyond just a body of water that has shaped part of our identity and civilisation and, besides being a point of connection between nations, has created a vital and unique route for the global economy at the Strait of Hormuz and thereafter the Sea of Oman. This strategic asset has aroused the greed of many devils over past centuries and there is a history of repeated aggressions by European and American foreigners, insecurity, losses and multiple threats to the country.
